Questions

When does the app launch?

There is no public launch date. Invites go out in small batches, and invited members get in first.

How do I get an invite?

Request one with your name, number and email. We will reach out when a spot opens for you.

Is it free?

Founding crew members get early access and perks. Pricing details will be shared with your invite.

Which devices are supported?

Early access runs on mobile. Tell us your phone when you request your invite.

Do I need a gym?

No. Plans are available for both gym and home training, and you tell the app what equipment you have.

What does the AI coach actually do?

It builds your plan, adjusts weights and reps after every session, and explains what to change next.
